description.value: Lifestyle Markets Health Foods is a natural health food store and supplement retailer with multiple locations across greater Victoria, including this Douglas Street location. They stock a broad range of organic produce, pantry staples, snacks, beverages, refrigerated and frozen items alongside vitamins and supplements — making it a solid health-focused resupply stop for touring cyclists. The store is wheelchair accessible per OSM.

address.value: 2950 Douglas Street, Unit 180, Victoria, BC V8T 4N4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active multi-location natural health food retailer in Victoria BC with an e-commerce presence and physical stores. The grocery section of the website explicitly lists organic produce, pantry staples, snacks, beverages, and refrigerated/frozen foods, confirming basic grocery availability. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, bike rack, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the scraped website content, so all such fields remain null.
concerns: Website is primarily an e-commerce front; scraped subpages are mostly navigation menus with minimal store-specific details, so cycling amenities and phone/address could not be confirmed from website text.
Lifestyle Markets operates at least three locations (Douglas Street, Cook Street Village, Sidney) — ensure no duplicate OSM records exist for the other locations that could cause confusion.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active natural health food grocery with organic produce, snacks, and beverages is a useful resupply point for touring cyclists in Victoria; the business is clearly operating with a live website and multiple physical locations.
